texts.buttonHint: Writes it into {file}; the old file is kept as .bak.
texts.title: Or add this to ~/.codex/config.toml yourself
texts.where: Codex CLI, IDE extension and app share this file; create it if it isn't there (Windows: C:\Users\you\.codex\config.toml). Keep tool_timeout_sec (30 min): Codex stops a tool after 60 s by default, and waiting for your review or chat message takes up to 25 min. Then restart Codex and type /mcp: third-wheel should be listed.
